experiment.comment: Based on the previous FR-cout paper of the authors (Stagni et al., 2020, https://doi.org/10.1039/c9re00429g), the "normal" conditions refer to p = 1 bar, T = 273.15 K.
Volumetric flow rates under normal (reference) conditions were calculated based on the Inlet flow rate data given in the Supplementary Material as follows: Q_tot = Q_NH3 + Q_H2 + Q_O2 + Q_He_tot.
If the temperature profile was not provided at the nominal temperature, it was estimated using linear interpolation from the two neighboring temperature profiles.
Temperature uncertainty was taken from the previous FR-cout paper of the authors (Stagni et al., 2020, https://doi.org/10.1039/c9re00429g).
